input.quote: Fees do not include taxes, reimbursable expenses, service credits, interest, damages, or a one-time implementation charge unless an Order Form expressly states otherwise.
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalty or early-termination charge is payable by Customer anywhere in the Agreement: service credits are referenced only as amounts flowing to us (Section 1.5), Section 7.3 lets us withhold disputed amounts, and Section 27.3 permits termination "without penalty" with a refund. Compliant as drafted; the take-or-pay in Section 2.1 is addressed under MINCOMMIT, and our termination-for-convenience insert states expressly that no early-termination charge applies so it cannot be recharacterised as a penalty.
